roomPalette.observed: Native details.open remained true after owner hiding and on another owner reentry.
roomPalette.rootCause: The retained owner DOM preserved the transient native disclosure state without an owner-exit reset. Canonical theme selection is independent.

projects.observed: Back to Work remained on Projects repeatedly. Cross-world reopening did expose the saved project; the reproduced failure was the parent return and its history sequence.
projects.rootCause: Canonical Projects routing pushed a route entry, then ownerSurface.show pushed a duplicate same-address entry. Back consumed that entry while popstate restored Projects. The same-world focus guard also suppressed parent reset when focus remained in owner tools.
